# BEGIN Static website (seancollinson.com)
# Paste this whole block at the very TOP of public_html/.htaccess, above everything else.
# Generated by build.mjs on 2026-10-09. Leave the WordPress rules below it exactly as they are.
# Scope: only seancollinson.com, and only the new site's own pages. WordPress, its REST API,
# OAuth / .well-known routing, and your other domains are not affected.

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
  RewriteEngine On
  # HTTP -> HTTPS and one canonical host (seancollinson.com), for this site only.
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^(www\.)?seancollinson\.com$ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/\.well-known/
  RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on [OR]
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^seancollinson\.com$ [NC]
  RewriteRule ^ https://seancollinson.com%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]

  # Old WordPress addresses -> the new pages (permanent redirects).
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^(www\.)?seancollinson\.com$ [NC]
  RewriteRule ^contact-us/?$ /contact/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^(www\.)?seancollinson\.com$ [NC]
  RewriteRule ^(home|hello-world)/?$ / [R=301,L]

  # /about/index.html -> /about/
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^(www\.)?seancollinson\.com$ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{THE_REQUEST} \s/+(.*/)?index\.html[\s?] [NC]
  RewriteRule ^(.*/)?index\.html$ /$1 [R=301,L]
</IfModule>

  Header always set Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()" "expr=%{HTTP_HOST} =~ m#^(www\.)?seancollinson\.com$#i && %{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#^/($|(about|mediation|consultation|videos|masterclass|contact|privacy-policy|terms-of-use|accessibility|disclaimer)(/|$)|assets/|forms/|404\.html$)#"
